note: Exploratory interface checks on one benchmark task, one run per arm. They are not part of the pilot matrix and must not be pooled with pilot results.
final_interface: The pilot uses the interface after all fixes below: forwarded flat schema with explicit read limits and action notes, parse reasons in malformed and rejected feedback, and arm-A submit/put semantics.

direct_arm_attempts.defect: The connector did not forward the harness action schema; the model guessed an unsupported format and repeated it.
The schema was ambiguous: a top-level actions array, nested fields objects and an allowlist field inside submit were copied literally.

direct_arm_attempts.note: Read, submitted one command batch, received the PASS certificate, finished.

arm_checks.defect: The direct-arm schema did not state that submit creates no files; the model submitted without writing an artifact.

The read example asked for 65536 bytes while the harness caps reads at (feedback_bytes-96)/4 = 1000, and action rejections omitted the reason. The model read 13 times and finished 15 times without usable data.

arm_checks.note: Interface behaved correctly: one read of all 475 bytes, one complete put of 475 bytes, submit, finish. The model ordered values descending with the empty value first, so the oracle correctly rejected a genuine model error.
Recovered from one concatenated-action rejection, read the input, submitted one python3 batch, finished. Raw tool feedback was returned.
Same path as B, but the independent verifier output was returned. Oracle and verifier agreed.

defects_found_and_fixed: luna-connector now appends the harness action schema to the provider instructions on every call.
The schema no longer has a wrapper array, nested fields objects, or an allowlist field inside submit; it has a flat catalog, flat parseable examples and explicit notes.
The read example and limit now match the harness byte cap derived from feedback_bytes, and the cap is stated in the notes.
Malformed-action and rejected-action feedback include the parser or execution reason, bounded by feedback_bytes.
The direct-arm instruction and schema state that put writes the artifact and submit creates no files.
Tool-arm notes state that inputs are already in the work tree and commands may read them directly.
controls_affected: Every interface change applies identically to all arms. Earlier smoke data used different interface text and is retained only as defect evidence, never as comparable measurement.
not_measured: Per-message feedback and verification token attribution remains null.
Monetary cost remains null; pricing is deferred.
These six live runs consumed ChatGPT Plus quota and are not a statistical sample.
